paola_cs: FYI MarinerX Logistics (contact: sara@marinerx.io) wants to onboard a domain-tuned manifest parser + anonymizer. Requirements: Private (customer VPC) + HSM for key ops, masking (not deletion) for downstream systems, and low-latency single-row lookups p95 <= 280ms. They asked for an eval plan, perf targets, and impact on renewal if they request reserved capacity. Who can own?
kevin_se: I'll take SE lead. Quick Qs: model framework/size? realtime or batch? Also do they expect us to host inside their VPC or allow a dedicated-hosted option?
paola_cs: Sara: PyTorch 2.1, ~7B, optimized for per-row realtime lookups. They prefer Private inside their VPC with HSM integration. NDA addendum required to restrict debug logs and telemetry retention.
rami_safety: Safety clarifying Qs: enumerate sensitive fields (customer_name, consignee_name, contact_phone, container_id, customs_ref). Any PHI? Any local/regulatory constraints (EU/UK/APAC) on customs refs? We'll need targeted adversarial redaction probes and prompt-injection stress tests.
paola_cs: Sara: no PHI. Sensitive = customer_name, consignee_name, phone, container_id, customs_ref. APAC customs refs flagged in scoped regs. They prefer fixed-mask tokens (e.g., <REDACTED_ID>) for masked fields.
mira_pm: Product constraints: ephemeral KV cache only, no persistent token storage. If we can't meet 280ms p95 in-customer VPC, ops may recommend a small Dedicated pool in-region which triggers reserved-capacity discussions and impacts renewal cadence. Flagging commercial risk. @oliver_sales please advise on pricing/renewal implications.
infra_bot: infra-bot: created ticket CS-11021 "marinerx manifest anonymizer onboard" https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/CS-11021 :white_check_mark:
kevin_se: Ops asks: please provide ~600 representative anonymized rows + schema + QPS/concurrency profile. Perf plan: run cold and warm KV cache sweeps, quantize to int8 for latency tests, and run canary in their VPC if allowed. Example perf command for infra team:
```
./perf_harness --model marinerx_artifact.pt --data samples.jsonl --qps 15 --concurrency 4 --quantize int8 --ephemeral-kv --out marinerx_perf.json
```
Use `--ephemeral-kv` both enabled and disabled to compare tails; include `--record-audit` only if NDA permits. ETA 48-72h after samples.
rami_safety: Proposed eval checklist (short): 1) redaction adversarial set (800 adversarial examples) 2) extraction precision/recall for canonical fields 3) prompt-injection / hallucination probes 4) latency p95/p99 at 10/15/25 QPS. Deliverables: redaction FNR/FPR, list of high-severity misses, per-endpoint p95/p99. Need anonymized samples by Thu to keep timeline.
oliver_sales: Noted. I'll draft pricing sketches for Dedicated-in-region + HSM surcharge and prepare renewal term options (month-to-month vs 12/24mo reserve). If they require reserved capacity for latency, that's a clear upsell but we need a usage ramp to justify. I'll join the QBR.
paola_cs: Scheduling a technical + infra sync with Sara and their infra lead next Wed 10am PT. I'll request the dataset, schema, and signed NDA addendum today. KEVIN: once samples land can you run perf + safety eval and post results here?
kevin_se: Yes 1 I'll prep the harness and safety eval runner. ETA 72h after data. Will post results and recommended deployment (Private in-VPC with HSM vs Dedicated fallback). :hourglass_flowing_sand:
paola_cs: Great, thanks all. I'll update CS-11021 with artifacts when Sara sends them and close loop on NDA addendum. :thumbsup:
